name: CMA CGM
verdict: French shipping and logistics group that the CMA CGM Foundation describes as family-owned; Rodolphe Saadé chairs its board. Nothing found.
note: Board members named by the group include members of the Saadé family shareholder and Robert Yüksel Yildirim (Turkish group Yildirim, a private company). No state or state fund with a record of serious abuses is named as an owner.
